zh-CN: 游戏结束时，队长击杀数较多的队伍将胜利。若击杀数相同则队长伤害较高的队伍胜利。
en-US: When the game ends, the team whose captain has more kills wins. If kills are tied, the team whose captain dealt more damage wins.
Remarks: 超级队长房间屏胜利条件

zh-CN: 命中与击杀可获取积分。任一方团灭即结束比赛，最终按团队积分判定胜负。积分较高者胜，积分相同则平局。
en-US: Hits and kills earn points. The match ends when either team is wiped out, and the winner is decided by team score. The higher score wins; equal scores are a draw.
Remarks: S2-2 TeamPage 胜利条件描述（火力积分）

zh-CN: 率先淘汰敌方全部成员的一方胜利。时间结束双方均未团灭时，比较双方存活人数，存活人数多的队伍获胜。
en-US: The first team to eliminate every enemy member wins. If neither team is wiped out when time runs out, the team with more survivors wins.
Remarks: S2-2 TeamPage 胜利条件描述（歼灭模式）

zh-CN: 任务目标
Remarks: S2-2 TeamPage 任务目标标题

zh-CN: 积极战斗得分，为团队扩大积分优势。
en-US: Fight actively to score and widen your team's lead.
Remarks: S2-2 TeamPage 任务目标描述（荣耀积分）

zh-CN: 尽量得分并保存战力，避免过早减员。
en-US: Score as much as you can and preserve your strength. Avoid losing members early.
Remarks: S2-2 TeamPage 任务目标描述（火力积分）

zh-CN: 持续交战积累积分，争取团队领先。
en-US: Keep fighting to build up points and take the team lead.
Remarks: S2-2 TeamPage 任务目标描述（攻防积分）

zh-CN: 消灭敌方成员，尽可能保住己方战力。
en-US: Eliminate enemy members while keeping as many of your own as possible.
Remarks: S2-2 TeamPage 任务目标描述（歼灭模式）

zh-CN: 人类需要尽力坚持存活到最后；丧尸需要追击并感染人类。
en-US: Humans must survive until the end. Zombies must hunt down and infect humans.
Remarks: 任务目标描述（生化模式）

zh-CN: 快速搜寻目标，尽快击灭全部靶灯。
en-US: Find the targets quickly and take out every target light as fast as you can.
Remarks: 任务目标描述（竞速模式）

zh-CN: 保存队伍战力，尽可能击杀其他队伍成员。
en-US: Preserve your team's strength and eliminate as many members of other teams as possible.
Remarks: 任务目标描述（联盟对战）

zh-CN: 队长需要争取更多击杀，队员需要保护己方队长并协助其进攻。
en-US: Captains must secure more kills. Teammates must protect their captain and support the attack.
Remarks: 任务目标描述（超级队长）
